prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1264; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing and paint transfer running along the rear quarter panel. The pattern of the damage lines up well with the low-speed impact that was described, and nothing I found suggests older harm to the vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, refinishing the quarter panel, and recalibrating the parking sensors. The labor hours listed are in line with work of this kind. The invoices submitted contain no duplicate line items or repeated charges, so the estimate can be processed as written.
